description: The only meta-level entry. Route a failure to an existing room, or propose a new one. Rooms are data; triage never builds executable code.

nodes.instruction: Given the failure and the list of existing rooms, set route_to to the best-matching room name. If none fits, leave it unset to propose a new room.
Propose a new room as declarative data; it must pass the validator and human approval before use.
